subject.title: Add typed Project Record composed block

question: Should the generic blocks package own this Project Record composed-block API, or should this portfolio-oriented composition remain in a consumer site?
rationale: The change adds a durable public API and renderer, while repository policy requires generic package boundaries and explicit approval before merge.

options.title: Sponsor the generic block
options.body: Approve the public composed-block direction and require real editor-to-renderer proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it consumer-owned
options.body: Decline the package API and move the project-specific composition to the portfolio consumer while retaining only reusable primitives here.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the generic block
recommendation.body: Approve the public composed-block direction and require real editor-to-renderer proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository policy names Bobby as the approval authority for merges and this public-surface decision.
